response: deferred to the owner as a new question: an acceptance change (whether a filer's own broad industry, printed once per company block and never GICS in any quarter, counts as industry coverage). The D-232 ruling for HPS (carry the filer's later GICS heading back) does not apply because this filer never prints GICS. Nothing implemented; the shared alias table was not applied (it would map broad industries onto single GICS sub-industries). The nine industry_coverage findings stay outstanding without a proposal. Fund agent's recommendation: count the printed filer industry as covered and add a reader step that carries it down each company block.
statement: Owner decision, same question as REQ-rfhc-1 (deferred under D-207): the filer prints its own twelve-label taxonomy (Software, Business Services, Healthcare, Consumer Services, Financial Services (& Technology), Education, Distribution & Logistics, Packaging, Food & Beverage, Business Products, Investment Fund) in the first cell of each company's first line, under a company heading row. Options: (a) industry coverage counts a published filer industry (extracted_industry) as covered, plus an opt-in reader step that carries that cell down the company block, with no GICS mapping; (b) keep coverage on GICS only and leave the nine quarters parked. Recommendation (a): the industry is on the page; a GICS sub-industry from these labels would be a guess.

response: deferred by the orchestrator to the second rule batch: pik_printed cannot parse this filer's 'N %/PIK' and 'A % + B %/PIK' forms, so it never tested 124 printed PIK lines. Making the rule test more rows changes what counts as a finding on every fund, so it is built and measured on the cohort with a false-alarm sample before it is switched on (owner 2026-10-18: new rules built in a worktree, measured, then merged). Nothing implemented now; the fund agent checked these lines by its own scan (whole_pik*.sql). AMENDED: the independent reviewer (rfnge) found the earlier claim that every '%/PIK' row publishes a printed figure was wrong: Associations Subordinated 2 at 2025-12-31 ("Fixed(Q)* 14.25 %/PIK 14.25 %") published no pik_rate. Fixed in rfngf by a row correction from the printed line; the fund agent's full scan (scratch/fund_runs/0001925531/pik_scan.sql, 185 rows printing a PIK figure in any form) finds none without a pik_rate and none matching neither the printed PIK nor the printed coupon. The deferral stands: until the rule is repaired, the ledger does not see this form, so rows like Associations are caught only by an agent's own scan.
statement: pik_printed (pik_printed_not_published) does not read the printed form 'N %/PIK' (slash between the percent sign and PIK): _PIK_PERCENT is number \s*%\s*\)?\s*PIK. This filer prints every PIK figure that way, so the rule never tested its 124 PIK lines and missed four rows with a printed PIK and none published (fixed here by row correction). Allow an optional '/' before PIK.
